rationale: Class 3 aggregate mismatch. The extracted 876-position fair-value sum is USD 37,223,203,000. Raw source therefore proves an extraction-population error, but the aggregate schedule structure does not safely identify a single culprit row; remediation should inspect row disposition/population scope.
